description: Outdated OpenSSL build vulnerable to out-of-bounds read of process memory via crafted heartbeat request.
solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.0.2u or later; rotate any keys/certs served by the affected host.

description: OpenSSH server allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames via crafted authentication requests.
Integer overflow in the range filter module can lead to worker process crash or memory disclosure.

plugin_name: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat File Read/Inclusion
description: AJP connector allows reading arbitrary files from the web application, and in some configurations code execution ("Ghostcat").
solution: Upgrade Tomcat to 9.0.31+ or disable/firewall the AJP connector.

plugin_name: PostgreSQL Privilege Escalation via ALTER ... DEPENDS ON EXTENSION
description: Certain search-path handling allows a low-privilege user to execute code as the extension owner.
solution: Upgrade PostgreSQL to 12.4 or later; audit extension ownership.

plugin_name: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution via Malformed Query
description: SQL Server Analysis Services component improperly handles a malformed query, permitting remote code execution.
solution: Apply vendor cumulative update or upgrade to SQL Server 2017+.
